title: RelShap: Relationally Consistent Shapley Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2608.11508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning pipelines commonly flatten relational data into single-table representations, discarding structural constraints. Widely used Shapley value-based feature attributions then rely on feature independence, evaluating the model on combinations that could never arise in the underlying data, producing misleading explanations. We propose RelShap, a framework that incorporates relational constraints and data provenance into Shapley value computation, restricting both background data and coalition evaluation to relationally valid configurations. The framework is estimator-agnostic and composes with Kernel SHAP, Monte Carlo, and Leverage SHAP without altering their sampling or weighting properties. Functional dependencies further induce equivalence classes over feature coalitions, which RelShap exploits to reduce runtime without changing Shapley values; we provide a combinatorial characterization of the expected speedup. Experiments

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11508v1 公告类型：新 摘要：机器学习流程通常将关系数据扁平化为单表表示，丢弃了结构约束。广泛使用的基于Shapley值的特征归因依赖于特征独立性，在底层数据中不可能出现的组合上评估模型，从而产生误导性解释。我们提出RelShap，一个将关系约束和数据溯源纳入Shapley值计算的框架，将背景数据和联盟评估都限制在关系上有效的配置中。该框架与估计器无关，并与Kernel SHAP、Monte Carlo和Leverage SHAP组合使用，而不改变其采样或加权性质。函数依赖进一步在特征联盟上诱导等价类，RelShap利用这些等价类在不改变Shapley值的情况下减少运行时间；我们提供了预期加速的组合特征描述。实验...
tldr: RelShap通过将关系约束和数据溯源融入Shapley值计算，限制评估到关系有效的配置，并在不改变Shapley值的前提下利用函数依赖等价类加速计算，解决了传统方法因特征独立性假设产生的误导性解释问题。
en_tdlr: RelShap incorporates relational constraints and data provenance into Shapley value computation, restricting evaluations to relationally valid configurations and exploiting functional dependency equivalence classes to accelerate computation without altering Shapley values, addressing misleading explanations caused by feature independence assumptions.
